subject.title: fix(codex): rotate bounded-turn auth profiles on usage limits

question: Should unpinned bounded Codex app-server turns use backup OpenAI auth profiles after a structured usage-limit failure, matching regular chat failover?
rationale: The implementation correctly fixes established broken behavior, but it intentionally changes which configured account may serve image, extraction, and hosted-search calls.

options.title: Accept bounded failover
options.body: Land so bounded turns follow configured auth order and existing quota cooldown state like chat attempts.

options.title: Keep bounded calls single-profile
options.body: Pause if bounded capabilities must never rotate accounts without an explicit future opt-in.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded failover
recommendation.body: Land so bounded turns follow configured auth order and existing quota cooldown state like chat attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the affected Codex turn-routing, auth, and rate-limit seams.
